summary: Nuvation Bio Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $250.0 million public offering of 0.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032, with an underwriter option for an additional $37.5 million. The notes are general unsecured obligations issued under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company. The filing also notes an amendment to a Revenue Interest Financing Agreement with Sagard Healthcare Partners to permit the notes issuance and related capped call transactions. This is a routine capital-raise event; no special-situation acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is involved.
